Unity Developer — BR Softech, Jaipur
Experience : 1 - 1.5 year
Job Description:
We are seeking a talented Unity Developer to join our dynamic team. As a Unity Developer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing game functionality, translating design ideas, concepts, and requirements into a functional and engaging game. You will collaborate closely with designers and other team members to deliver high-quality, scalable, and optimized solutions.
Responsibilities:
- Implement game functionality as per communicated design.
- Translate design specification into functional game code.
- Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
- Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
- Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to address and mitigate these issues.
- Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Proven experience as a Unity Developer with at least 1 year of professional experience.
- Strong knowledge of Unity2D, including experience with scripting, textures, animation, GUI styles, and user session management.
- Experience with game physics and particle systems.
- Experience optimizing memory and space usage for support of older hardware.
- Ability to constantly learn and stay in touch with evolving game standards and development technologies.
- Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and software design patterns.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with VR and AR development.
- Familiarity with level design and planning.
- Experience with game analytics and user behavior analysis.
